about.description: An AI assistant that can use your CLI and Editor. Cline can handle complex software development tasks step-by-step with tools that let him create & edit files, explore large projects, use the browser, and execute terminal commands (after you grant permission).

separateModels.description: Switching between Plan and Act mode will persist the API and model used in the previous mode. This may be helpful e.g. when using a strong reasoning model to architect a plan for a cheaper coding model to act on.
separateModels.label: Use different models for Plan and Act modes

apiKeyField.helpText: This key is stored locally and only used to make API requests from this extension.
apiKeyField.label: {{providerName}} API Key
apiKeyField.signupText: Sign up here to get your {{providerName}} API key.

apiOptions.providersRemoteManagedTooltip: Provider options are managed by your organization's remote configuration

debug.resetGlobalStateDescription: This will reset all global state and secret storage in the extension.

backgroundEdit.description: Allow edits without stealing editor focus
backgroundEdit.label: Background Edit

checkpoints.description: Save progress at key points for easy rollback
checkpoints.label: Checkpoints

compactionStrategy.description: Controls how auto compaction rewrites context.
compactionStrategy.label: Auto Compact Strategy

featureTips.description: Show rotating tips during the thinking phase to help you discover Cline features.
featureTips.label: Feature Tips

hooks.description: Enable lifecycle and tool hooks during task execution.
hooks.label: Hooks

mcpDisplayMode.description: Controls how MCP responses are displayed
mcpDisplayMode.label: MCP Display Mode

webSearch.description: Let the model search the web when the selected provider and model support it. Applies to new tasks.
webSearch.label: Web Search

worktrees.description: Enables git worktree management for running parallel Cline tasks.
worktrees.label: Worktrees

telemetry.description: Help improve Cline by sending usage data and error reports. No code, prompts, or personal information are ever sent. See our <telemetryLink>telemetry overview</telemetryLink> and <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for more details.
telemetry.label: Allow error and usage reporting

providerRouting.defaultDescription: Load balance across providers (AWS, Google Vertex, etc.), prioritizing price while considering uptime
providerRouting.label: Provider Routing
providerRouting.latencyDescription: Sort by response time, prioritizing lowest latency
providerRouting.priceDescription: Sort by price, prioritizing the lowest cost provider
providerRouting.throughputDescription: Sort by throughput, prioritizing highest throughput (may increase cost)

modelPicker.autoFetchFreeTip: You can also try searching "free" for no-cost options currently available.
modelPicker.autoFetchNote: The extension automatically fetches the latest list of models available on <providerLink>{{provider}}</providerLink>. If you're unsure which model to choose, compare available models by context window, pricing, and capabilities.
modelPicker.clineAutoFetchNote: The extension automatically fetches the latest Cline model list.
modelPicker.label: Model
modelPicker.vercelEnterApiKey: Enter your Vercel AI Gateway API key above to load available models. You can get an API key from <gatewayLink>Vercel AI Gateway</gatewayLink>.
modelPicker.vercelSelectModel: Select a model from the dropdown above. The extension fetches available models from your Vercel AI Gateway configuration.

preferredLanguage.description: The language that Cline should use for communication.
preferredLanguage.label: Preferred Language

reasoningEffort.adaptiveDescription: Use None to disable adaptive thinking. Higher effort increases response detail and token usage.
reasoningEffort.description: Higher effort improves depth, but uses more tokens.
reasoningEffort.extendedDescription: Use None to disable extended thinking. Higher effort improves depth, but uses more tokens.
reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning Effort

remoteConfig.managedNote: These settings are managed by your organization's remote configuration.
remoteConfig.notSetup: You haven't configured remote config yet. Do so through our <dashboardLink>dashboard</dashboardLink>.
remoteConfig.optedOut: You have opted out of remote config. Opt back in to apply it and see it here.

otel.flushSuccess: Flushed buffers! Please check the output channel for more detailed information
otel.title: OpenTelemetry Configuration

remoteManaged.tooltip: This setting is managed by your organization's remote configuration

defaultProfile.description: Select the default terminal Cline will use. 'Default' uses your VSCode global setting.
defaultProfile.label: Default Terminal Profile

executionMode.description: Choose whether Cline runs commands in the VS Code terminal or a background process.
executionMode.label: Terminal Execution Mode

reuse.description: When enabled, Cline will reuse existing terminal windows that aren't in the current working directory. Disable this if you experience issues with task lockout after a terminal command.
reuse.label: Enable aggressive terminal reuse

shellTimeout.description: Set how long Cline waits for shell integration to activate before executing commands. Increase this value if you experience terminal connection timeouts.
shellTimeout.label: Shell integration timeout (seconds)

troubleshooting.text: Having terminal issues? Check our Terminal Quick Fixes or the Complete Troubleshooting Guide.

uiLanguage.description: The language used for Cline's interface.
uiLanguage.label: Display Language
